evidence.quoted_text:
base.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        require(not base.stat().st_mode & 0o077,
                "private record directory must have mode 0700: " + str(base))
        name = ("run-" + time.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ", time.gmtime())
                + "-" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:6])
        self.run_dir = base / name
        self.run_dir.mkdir(mode=0o700)
evidence.reason: claim_run_dir creates the record base and run directory but never fsyncs the containing directory entries. durable_write(path, receipt) only syncs the receipt and its parent run directory, so a crash can persist the admission hold while losing the run directory entry in the record base and any newly created record-base chain. The code needs to sync the record base (and its created parent) before treating admission as durable.
